title: Undead
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Every undead family placed or spawned as an enemy, draugr included (user, 2026-09-30). An undead that exists only as a summon is under Conjured. The sub-groups move here one at a time: Vampires first; Draugr, Skeletons, Ghosts, Ash, Dragon Priests and the Creation Club undead are still to come.
